description: This file defines a journaled grain for seat reservations in an Orleans-based distributed application. It includes the main grain class 'SeatReservationGrain', its state class 'ReservationState', and the reservation data class 'SeatReservation'. The grain handles seat reservation requests and maintains state with event sourcing and storage provider configurations.

classes.name: SeatReservationGrain
classes.description: A journaled grain managing seat reservations, records events, and updates reservation state.

classes.name: ReservationState
classes.description: Represents the state of the seat reservation grain, including a dictionary of reservations.

classes.name: SeatReservation
classes.description: Data class encapsulating seat number and user ID for reservations.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Handles a seat reservation request, enqueues the event, waits for propagation, and verifies success.
